onlyOpen: Schedules run only while Crewyard is open, also from the tray. Nothing runs while the app is closed. After sleep or a restart, up to 3 missed runs are caught up, one at a time.
empty: No schedules yet. A schedule proposes a task daily or weekly; nothing starts without the crew's approval unless you turn on auto-approve.

errors.load: Schedules could not be loaded from the background service.
